title: [1080p/FHD, 720p/HD, mixed res] JAV Bunny Girl Megapack 2 No Watermarks
description:
### Bunny Girl

#### Lots of non-VR titles tagged Bunny Girl on R18

Happy Easter! Similar to my Bunny Girl VR Megapack (https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/3198454) I bring you the non-VR version. Do you love the classic Playboy Bunny look? Then this pack will bring you plenty of joy. Keep in mind that the actual, original costume is trademarked, so different studios will have different variations on it, some subtle, some obvious. The new "Reverse Bunny" look, for example, is also included, though I think only WAAA-001 has that, since it's relatively new. The best thing to do is check the covers. It'll give you an idea both what the Bunny costume will look like, and whether it'll be the focus of the movie or just one costume out of many in a cosplay-themed title. Some movies also may only contain bunny ears, not the whole costume. Either way, I think SP-368 says it best: https://imgur.com/JFD8fP4

Keep in mind I'm going mostly by the R18 tags, which are down to the studios. Studios vary in reliability when it comes to that, like Prestige tagging half their library Deep Throat. But that's another story.

This pack contains 139 movies, with another 123 in Part 1. They were selected by three criteria: 1. The movie is tagged Bunny Girl. 2. There's someone wearing a Bunny costume on the movie's cover. 3. I know from memory that the movie contains someone in a Bunny costume. The vast majority were selected by tags, so some may be wrong. The screens should help determine that.

This megapack is **NOT EXHAUSTIVE** at the time of uploading. NOTE: R18/DMM have removed countless 1080p versions of movies before ~December 2015. Those version are only available at 720p now. That means future megapacks (including this one) might contain 720p movies that were once available in 1080p. If you come across one of those, that's not an error, it's simply the best we can do now. What a great service, I wonder why people want to pirate their shit en masse?

JPEG XL’s lossy mode provides equal quality to JPEG at 60% smaller file sizes, and its lossless mode enables file sizes 35% smaller on average compared to PNG (incidentally, manga seems to compress much better than average: using -q 100 -s 9 -E 3 -I 1, I attained a better than 49% size reduction on this doujin I’ve tested, compared to the zipped PNG files on FAKKU.) It has a bevy of other features too, including alpha channel support, animation, progressive decoding, and high bit depths (up to 32-bit [float] per channel), and image dimensions that cap at 1,073,741,823 x 1,073,741,824 pixels. Most of that isn’t relevant to manga, but it’s still quite cool. It also has a special feature: the ability to losslessly recompress existing JPEG files, to reduce file sizes another ~20%; the old JPEGs can even be perfectly recreated from the JPEG XL files produced in this way! JPEG XL is totally capable of perfectly replacing JPEG, GIF, PNG, and WebP! Here are some links to get started:

Sample results for lossless compression:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ju4q1WkaXT7WoxZINmQpf4ElgMD2VMlqeDN2DuZ6yJ8

Source code:
https://gitlab.com/wg1/jpeg-xl

Specification document:
https://arxiv.org/ftp/arxiv/papers/1908/1908.03565.pdf

Official website:
https://jpeg.org/jpegxl/

Viewer:
https://imageglass.org/moon

A precompiled windows binary:
https://encode.su/threads/3564-JXL-version-0-3-released?p=69282&viewfull=1#post69282

Discord server (click the image tab):
https://discord.gg/HSBxne3

In the linked zip file with the binaries, cjxl.exe can be used to convert files to JPEG XL, and djxl.exe can be used to decode JPEG XL files, and export as a different format. You can use -h -v to get information about the functions of the binaries. If you want to batch convert lots of PNG files to JPEG XL, here is a suggestion for how to do so: Move the PNG files into the folder where cjxl.exe is located, click on the Windows Explorer address bar (when you are in that folder) and type ‘cmd’ (without the quotes) and hit ‘ENTER’ on your keyboard. Then use the following command:

for %i in (D:\jpeg-xl\*.png) do cjxl “%i” “%i.jxl” -q 100 -s 9 -E 3 -I 1

Set the location in the brackets to wherever your binary and PNG files are. You may also visit ‘https://squoosh.app/’ to work with JPEG XL files, as well as other formats, and to convert between them.
